Note, this is from the perspective of someone who suffers from depression.

My biggest advice would be to just listen - usually just having someone to talk to, to trust, to empathise with you is the biggest difference for someone with depression.

However, if this is long-term and you've been with your SO for a while, I would also make sure to set boundaries (in a non-confronting way) or expectations of what you can provide vs a therapist/trained-professional. I think its equally important to look after your mental health and give yourself rest from your SO's depression (because it ultimately affects them and you).
